Verteron.note: image px = offset + scale * world coordinate (x -> right, y -> down), no flip or rotation; the composite is 2048 px wide for the 8x8 tiles, multiply by 8 for the native 16384 px map
Verteron.fit: refitted 2026-10-08 evening on all 5272 pet-monster spawn points plus the south-west island (Insel der Ewigkeit) with extra weight: 96.9 % of all spawn points and 99.5 % of those on the island lie on land (the first fit had 61 % on the island, the Kerubian groups lay in the lagoon). The scale now agrees with Altgard's independent fit within 0.5 %. The two recorded places moved by about 55 m.

Altgard.note: image px = offset + scale * world coordinate (x right, y down, no flip or rotation); fitted on the 1024 px overview of Karte_Altgard.png, the 8192 px map is 8x that
Altgard.fit: least squares on four places of a recording matched with the map screenshots (Klarwald, Absturzstelle x2, Namenloser Friedhof); residual up to 6 px on the 1024 overview = about 50 m; 79 % of the pet-monster spawn points on land. The scale differs 5 % from Verteron's, so the error grows towards the far edges.
